Thanks for the quick note — below are the two settlement paths and the implications so you can pick what works best for PayCorp:

1) USD wire to Redwood (fastest)
- Bank: JP Morgan Chase (US)
- Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.

- ABA/SWIFT: 021000021 / CHASUS33
- Beneficiary address: 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105, USA
- Reference: INV-9987 / PayCorp CNPJ 12.345.678/0001-90

Notes for USD path: intermediary/correspondent banks may apply additional fees (typically US$15–50 depending on routing). There are three common charge instructions:
- OUR: payer covers all fees (we receive gross amount) — recommended if you need predictable net settlement at our end.
- SHA: fees split (payer pays their bank fees, beneficiary pays intermediary/receiving bank fees) — common but can result in net-of-fees on receipt.
- BEN: beneficiary bears all fees (not recommended for invoices).

If PayCorp wants to ensure Redwood receives the invoice amount in full, please ask your bank to send with OUR. If your bank refuses to send OUR, we can accept SHA but will need to be notified so we can either net up or issue a short credit for any material deduction (please provide MT103/SWIFT copy if deductions occur).

2) BRL local collection (lower FX exposure for you, slightly longer clearing)
- Method: local collection via Redwood's Brazilian collection partner (local clearing in BRL).
- Required beneficiary details we need from you to proceed with this route: full payer company name, branch and CNPJ (you already provided CNPJ), and the exact account name to be debited. We will provide a specific local-collection account number once you confirm you prefer BRL.

Timing: BRL local collection usually posts in 2–3 business days after initiation. USD wire to the US is same-day/next-day depending on cutoffs but can be subject to intermediary latencies.

VAT/tax items:
- Redwood is a US company and typically issues invoices without Brazilian VAT (ISS). For PayCorp's local tax treatment you can use the invoice plus our attached tax summary (redwood_tax_summary.pdf) to support your accounting. If PayCorp requires an invoice from a local entity, we can explore invoicing from our EU/EMEA entity — let me know and I will loop legal/finance.

I attached: INV-9987-20260731.pdf (invoice), wire_template_usd.txt (copy-paste template for your bank), and redwood_tax_summary.pdf.

Next steps: confirm whether you want USD (OUR) or BRL local collection and which AP contact will send the payment. If USD is chosen but YOUR bank cannot send OUR, please forward the MT103 so we can reconcile.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if helpful.
